title: Cargo-name-blind wrapper operations with full S3 equivariance on retained transport worlds
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED. Add the explicit content assumption that every retained wrapper is an operation unable to select a named cargo or inspect an external hazard/context role. Require F(sigma(x))=sigma(F(x)) for all six cargo permutations. Actual WRAP01 l and WRAP03 qok cells give two distinct repeated-operation consequences beyond1014 free functions; no old dictionary or world is silently repaired.
question: Can any retained complete transport reading admit wrapper operations that preserve anonymous cargo identity or erase it uniformly, without hidden access to the cargo name, context or danger-graph role?
retained_scope: All36 original dictionaries, their unchanged valid settings, original63-group f83r block, and both complete f50r readings.52 canonical full-dictionary classes/312 member-context cases remain the population if a later registered full-world search is justified. All prior source/seam uncertainty stays conditional. No1015 dictionary is mixed into transport.

new_assumption.content: Affixes in the inherited complete length1-3 recurrent wrapper inventory are participant-neutral operations, not names, selectors of an unmentioned particular animal/material, or queries of the hazard graph. The input is exactly one existing terminal value, as in1014; there is no hidden world-state, paragraph-position or referent argument.
new_assumption.not_implied_by_symmetry: Global renaming of an entire fitted dictionary and its function table is already possible. Requiring ONE unchanged function to commute internally with every cargo permutation is an additional semantic law. It does not follow from arbitrary cargo naming.
new_assumption.not_a_morpheme_claim: The inherited literal wrapper inventory is not a confirmed segmentation. This tests the entire existing inventory; no problematic wrapper is dropped after a result.

complete_action.atomic_rule: sigma maps W/G/C by the listed permutation and fixes every listed other terminal. In particular M,B,FIRST_CARGO,OTHER_CARGO and every operation/grammar marker remain fixed as TERMINAL DESCRIPTORS.
complete_action.argument_bearing_values: The47-terminal interface contains no PAIR_W_G-style atomic value. PAIR and COPY runtime nodes carry cargo arguments separately. If a check traverses those runtime structures, sigma acts recursively on every cargo-valued argument, hazard edge, location key, first/recent introduction list and reference result; it preserves field names and argument order. A hypothetical added PAIR_W_G terminal would have to be modeled as PAIR(W,G) and mapped to PAIR(sigma(W),sigma(G)); adding such values is outside this proposal.
complete_action.contextual_references: FIRST_CARGO/OTHER_CARGO descriptors remain fixed, while their denotations change appropriately when the entire context is renamed. The wrapper may manipulate the descriptor but cannot dereference it to a concrete W/G/C without a context input. This deliberately strong interface restriction is a potential countercase, not an inferred linguistic truth.
complete_action.equation: For each inherited L_p or R_s, every x in the full47-terminal domain, and each of the six sigma: F(sigma(x)) = sigma(F(x)). Undefined observed cells require a common equivariant total completion; no cells are separately refitted per permutation.
complete_action.finite_normal_form: For each invariant input, the output must be one of the44 invariant terminals. Over the three-cargo orbit, F must be either identity on W/G/C or a constant taking all three to one invariant terminal. There is no deterministic equivariant unary selection of a DIFFERENT cargo from a single cargo input. This normal form is equivalent to checking all six permutations.
complete_action.remaining_freedom: Per wrapper: one of 45 cargo-orbit actions (identity or one of44 fixed outputs), plus one of44 outputs for each of44 invariant input cells. Observed equalities constrain these choices. No claim that this alone forms a sparse complete semantics; many invariant-to-invariant cells remain free.

predicted_consequences: WRAP01 L_l(W)=W from chedy/lchedy forces L_l(C)=C and L_l(G)=G. Its actual dy=C,ldy=ALONE assignment violates that same operation at a second attested input. A fresh allowed full-world map would have to keep dy outside the concrete cargo orbit; it may not change the original lchedy or ldy value.

WRAP03 L_qok(W)=UNATTENDED from chedy/qokchedy forces L_qok(G)=UNATTENDED and L_qok(C)=UNATTENDED. Its actual y=G,qoky=FERRY assignment violates the second attested input. Any fresh compatible full-world map would require y outside the cargo orbit.

Original L02_024 has chedy=C,lchedy=G. The permutation exchanging G and W while fixing C gives a direct one-cell stabilizer contradiction: F(C) cannot simultaneously beG andW. Original L02_009 hasC->C and does not have this particular contradiction. These exposed examples do not claim an exhaustive36-case result.

rivals_and_limits.free_function_rival: The unchanged1014 arbitrary unary functions allow both observed witness pairs and remain positive under their original registered law. They are not invalidated retroactively.
rivals_and_limits.context_role_rival: An affix can select the other member of a written hazard pair or a named cargo if its semantic input includes that context. Such a genuinely argument-bearing operation can be equivariant jointly in(x,context) while failing the unary law here. This proposal does not exclude it; adding the omitted context would be a new writer contract, not a rescue after failure.
rivals_and_limits.nonselection: All six global cargo-name renamings remain indistinguishable in any success. No animal/material name, affix meaning or language is identified.

smallest_decision_changing_test.stage1: Before a decoder, independently reconstruct all36 original dictionaries and the inherited original-only recurrent wrappers. Check exact equivariant completion by all6 permutations and by the finite orbit normal form. Publish every allowed/excluded original class. This can distinguish actual candidate identity relations where1014 could not.
smallest_decision_changing_test.stage2_gate: Only if stage1 leaves a meaningful nonempty proper set and root selects continuation, freeze an exact complete52-class counterpart of1014 with the added law and unchanged grammar/worlds. Include every class, not only the convenient survivors; old original-incompatible classes get explicit contradictions. No new target data or additional whole meanings beyond already allowed extension variables.
smallest_decision_changing_test.two_outcomes: If every retained original fails, close the participant-neutral unary-affix conjunction. If all surviving originals retain full extensions, report remaining nonseparation and stop; do not automatically add injectivity, more laws or a different affix list. Saved-witness failure alone never excludes a full extension.
smallest_decision_changing_test.budget_scope: Inclusive original review, minimal equations, validation, report/publication; no generic decoder or controls project.

known_counterexamples: WRAP01 andWRAP03 cells above are pre-exposed violations of the proposed law, not new discovery.
Original L02_024 shows that some currently retained dictionaries genuinely use l to change concrete cargo identity.
GDT608 retains whole-form/context residuals; unary identity-blind functions may be the wrong writing assumption.
IDEA433 leaves event-order and component contracts unresolved; this proposal neither repairs it nor assumes its qok/e table.
